search_text:
若 $\Omega$ 是由曲面 $z=\frac{x^2+y^2+z^2}{2}$ 与 $z=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ 所围含 $z$ 轴的立体区域，则立体 $\Omega$ 的体积用球面坐标可表示为（ ） $\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi/4}d\varphi\int_0^{2\cos\varphi}r^2\sin\varphi\,dr$ $\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^\pi d\varphi\int_0^{2\cos\varphi}r^2\sin\varphi\,dr$ $\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi/4}d\varphi\int_0^1r^2\sin\varphi\,dr$ $\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi/2}d\varphi\int_0^1r^2\sin\varphi\,dr$ 由 $\begin{cases}x^2+y^2+z^2=2z\\z=x^2+y^2\end{cases}$，则 $\begin{cases}x^2+y^2=1\\z=1\end{cases}$，于是 $\Omega:\quad\begin{cases}0\leq\theta\leq2\pi\\0\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{4}\\0\leq r\leq2\cos\varphi\end{cases}$，

$$
V=\iiint_\Omega1dV=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^{2\cos\varphi}r^2\sin\varphi\,dr.
$$
